user.title: Set up Loxone
user.description: Configure your Loxone Miniserver connection. The form is only submitted once the Miniserver accepts the credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the PyLoxone credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The Miniserver rejected the stored username and password. Enter the credentials once more - they are checked against the Miniserver before anything is saved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Miniserver. Check the IP address and port, and that the device is reachable.
error.invalid_auth: The Miniserver rejected the username and password.
error.invalid_host: The Miniserver IP / hostname, or the username or password, is missing or not a valid value.
error.invalid_username_encoding: Username contains characters that are not latin-1 compatible
error.invalid_password_encoding: Password contains characters that are not latin-1 compatible

init.title: PyLoxone settings
init.description: Preferences for the Loxone integration (connection details are changed through the reauth flow).

data.generate_scenes_delay: Delay for the scene generation if enabled

reload.name: Pyloxone Reload
reload.description: Reloads the Loxone integration by reconnecting to the Miniserver and refreshing all entities. This is useful after making configuration changes in Loxone Config or when connection issues occur. All current entity states will be re\-synchronized from the Miniserver.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Optional config entry id to restrict the reload to one Miniserver instance (default: all loxone entries).

event_websocket_command.name: Send Websocket command
event_websocket_command.description: Send websocket commands to the loxone server. You can send a command to the Miniserver using an entity or using a UUID. If you specify both, the command will be sent to the Entity. More info and commands can be found on the Loxone Website

uuid.name: UUID
uuid.description: Uuid for entity which you want to send a command.

device.name: Entity
device.description: Device which you want to send a command

value.name: Command
value.description: Command which you want to send

event_secured_websocket_command.name: Send secured websocket command
event_secured_websocket_command.description: Send websocket commands to the loxone server. You can send a command to the Miniserver using an entity or using a UUID. If you specify both, the command will be sent to the Entity. More info and commands can be found on the Loxone Website

uuid.name: UUID
uuid.description: Uuid for entity which you want to send a command.

device.name: Entity
device.description: Device which you want to send a command

value.name: Command
value.description: Command which you want to send

sync_areas.name: Sync areas
sync_areas.description: Applies areas to the loxone entites based on the room from loxone. If area not exists entites will not be changed

create_areas.name: Create areas
create_areas.description: Force to create areas when they not exist in HA

enable_sun_automation.name: Enable sun automation
enable_sun_automation.description: Enable Sun automation for Loxone Jalousie

disable_sun_automation.name: Disable sun automation
disable_sun_automation.description: Disable Sun automation for Loxone Jalousie

quick_shade.name: Quick shade
quick_shade.description: Move Loxone Jalousie to shade position. Position is set by Loxone depends on multiple values.

yaml_config_present.title: Loxone YAML configuration is no longer supported
yaml_config_present.description: A `loxone:` block is left in `configuration.yaml`. It was never read since the integration uses config entries, so remove it and recreate the Miniserver as a config entry (Settings > Devices & Services).

auth_failed.title: Loxone Miniserver rejected the stored credentials
auth_failed.description: The Miniserver at {host} rejected the stored username and password. A re-authentication has been started for this entry (Settings > Devices & Services > Loxone > Re-authentication). The entry and its entities stay down until the re-authentication is completed.

unsupported_firmware.title: Loxone Miniserver firmware is not supported
unsupported_firmware.description: The Miniserver reports firmware {version} and the integration requires at least {minimum}. Update the Miniserver firmware (Loxone Config app) and reload the entry. Until then the JSON websocket session this integration relies on may not be available.
